999008199.text: 永遠！　ここにいたでござるか

鬼門か。実家への報告も終わったから、
少し町を見て回ろうかと思ってね

localizations.en: Oh, Kimon. I finished reporting back to my family, so I thought I'd take a look around town.

999008199.text: 鏑矢への報告はどうだった？

localizations.en: How did your report to Kaburaya go?

999008199.text: あ、それなのでござるが……にんともかんとも

localizations.en: Ah, well, about that... it's a bit complicated.

999008199.text: 武装計画……

永遠も初耳でござるか。
拙者も初めて聞いて、少し驚いたでござる

localizations.en: So this is news to you too? I was quite surprised when I heard about it myself.

999008199.text:
でも鏑矢様のことだから、
きっと何か考えがあってのことでござるよ！

localizations.en: But knowing Lady Kaburaya, I'm sure she has her reasons!

999008199.text:
考えか……
この平和な時代に必要なものとも思えないが……

localizations.en: Her reasons, huh... I can't imagine what we'd need armaments for in these peaceful times...

999008199.text:
ところで、
話に出てきたコウセンとはいったい誰なんだ？

localizations.en: By the way, who exactly is this Kosen that came up in the conversation?

999008199.text:
少し前、ちょうど永遠が修行で不在だったときに
鏑矢様が迎えた陰陽師でござるよ！

localizations.en: He's a diviner that Lady Kaburaya brought in not too long ago, right when you were away for training!

999008199.text: なぁにぃ。陰陽師ぃ？　そいつは妬けるぜ

localizations.en: What? Another diviner? Well, that makes me a bit jealous.

999008199.text: コウセンとやらの陰陽師としての実力はどうなんだ？

localizations.en: How skilled is this Kosen as a diviner?

999008199.text:
それはもう、鏑矢様が認めたのですから！
ケイウン一とも思える優秀な陰陽師と聞いたでござる！

localizations.en: Of course! Lady Kaburaya recognized his abilities! I've heard he's an exceptionally talented diviner, perhaps the finest in all of Keiun!

999008199.text:
それにコウセン殿は的確な助言をくれるそうで、
鏑矢様もとても頼りにしているようでござる

localizations.en: And I hear Lord Kosen gives very sound advice, so Lady Kaburaya has come to rely on him quite heavily.

999008199.text:
そうだったのか。で、そのコウセンが
鏑矢に武装計画を勧めていると……ふーん

localizations.en: I see. So this Kosen is the one recommending the armament project to Kaburaya... Hmm.

999008199.text:
よし。この後、城へ行ったときに
コウセンへ挨拶してみようかな

localizations.en: All right. Next time I go to the castle, I think I'll introduce myself to Kosen.

999008199.text:
同じ陰陽師として、そして鏑矢の幼馴染として、
挨拶しないわけにはいかないからね

localizations.en: As a fellow diviner, and as Kaburaya's childhood friend, it wouldn't be right not to greet her.

999008199.text:
挨拶は大事でござるからな。
拙者もお供しまする！

localizations.en: Proper greetings are important. I'll come with you!

999008199.text: ああ。分かった

（コウセン……ケイウン一の陰陽師、ねえ。
　まったく、どういうことだ？）

localizations.en: (Kosen... The finest diviner in all of Keiun, huh? Something doesn't add up here.)

999008199.text:
（同じ陰陽師の俺が、その名を聞いたことが
　ないというのは）

localizations.en: (It's suspicious that I, a fellow diviner, have never even heard of him before.)
